data.gender_notes: Upen is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Upen is the name of the sun god Surya, who is the lord of the morning sky. He is the god of light, energy, and life, and is often depicted riding a chariot drawn by seven horses. The name Upen carries the meaning “Lord of the Morning” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Upen usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the morning and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Upen total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Upen has robust roots in Hindu culture, as it is the name of the Sun God, Surya, who is a significant deity in Hinduism. This powerful solar deity is responsible for the daily cycle of life, and is a symbol of vitality, strength, and wisdom. The name Upen is thus deeply connected to the vibrant and dynamic Hindu tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Upen holds immense significance as it is associated with Seeraditya, the ancient solar king who was considered as the embodiment of power, nobility, and divinity. The name Upen evokes a sense of purity and radiance, reflecting the divine light and energy that emanate from the Sun God. It is a name that inspires hope, strength, and a deep sense of reverence, reminding us of the infinite wisdom and power of the divine.
